paragraphs: Shmuel bar Mari-Mordekhai. See the entry Shmuel bar Bidri.[^1]

notes.text: מרי־מרדכי is joined by a dash in the supplied heading, retained as Mari-Mordekhai. Whether it represents one name or two is not settled. The target is bar Bidri. Earlier machine OCR had שמואי rather than supplied שמואל.
